name: clock

storage.rationale: This safeguard does not persist a host file or directory; the explicit empty declaration records that its effect is runtime-only or externally owned.

description: Verify and synchronize system clock accuracy for TLS and authentication

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: The macOS clock provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is clock_gettime through the system clock APIs.

windows.evidence: The Windows clock provider is not wired into this safeguard yet; the host mechanism is GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime.
